# Tutorial Card — Production and Publication Acceptance

> Copy into `tutorials/<slug>/TUTORIAL-CARD.md` for each project. Must link [Runbook](TUTORIAL-RUNBOOK.md) and [SOP](../docs/TUTORIAL-CONTENT-WORKFLOW.md).

- **Tutorial ID / slug**:
- **Primary category**: TUTORIAL_BUILD_AND_LEARN
- **Learner** (beginner/intermediate; role):
- **Value scope classification**: EFFICIENCY_WORKFLOW / BUILD_TO_SELL / CREATOR_TECH_OPS / TECHNICAL_ENABLER / GENERAL_BUSINESS_ONLY(HOLD) / UNSAFE_OR_OBSOLETE(REJECT):
- **Job/user and repeat frequency**:
- **AI causal mechanism** (inputs → steps → outputs; why it is AI/technical not general business advice):
- **Path A productivity** (manual baseline, AI operating time, human QA/rework, failure/error, deployment cost; unknown=unmeasured):
- **Path B monetization** (paying buyer hypothesis, authorized deliverable, acquisition channel, offer/price HYPOTHESIS, unit costs, willingness-to-pay pilot):
- **Six scorecard fields, each /5**: job specificity / AI mechanism / evidence / feasible reproduction / measurable value / legal-cost realism; total __/30, mandatory evidence/reproduction/legal ≥4, score ≥24:
- **Compliance stop/reject**: no fake sales/identity/region, licensing, data, monetization policy freshness, tax/payment claims:
- **Value gate decision**: ELIGIBLE_FOR_LAB / RESEARCH_HOLD / REJECT, see [Value Gate](../docs/TUTORIAL-VALUE-AND-MONETIZATION-GATE.md):
- **One actual outcome**:
- **Question/demand provenance**: original X/YouTube/Xiaohongshu/GitHub question URL, count provenance (if claiming high engagement):
- **Upstream original repo/docs** (full URL + author + licence + commit/version/date):
- **Permission / attribution status**:
- **Prerequisites** (accounts, device, OS, GPU, budget, privacy):
- **Estimated execution duration** (only if measured / reliable official source):
- **Exact steps source**: tutorial README and sample files:
- **Step checkpoint examples** (commands/actions → expected visible result):
- **Original reproduction**: NOT_RUN / FAILED / PASS; tested on OS, date, revision; supporting safe redacted screenshot/log:
- **Common failure and recovery**:
- **Version drift / maintenance owner**:
- **Business value** (task bottleneck, measurable test, buyer only if relevant; assumption explicitly marked):
- **Read-only tutorial URL** (actual repository link; blank until exists):
- **X publication copy** (1–3 posts max; weighted count):
- **Mandatory image package**: PNG/JPG verified path/link (and optional SVG source), exact 16:9, English ALT:
- **Image QA**: first-glance idea / source specificity / hierarchy / mobile / factual accuracy 0–2 each; hard failures:
- **Final lesson gate**: research_only / REPRO_PENDING / repro_verified / needs_revalidation:
- **X media gate**: image_missing / media_ready / approved:
- **X publication**: draft / scheduled / published; real status URL only after actual posting:
- **Content correction / feedback / next review date**:

## Critical questions before calling it a full tutorial

- [ ] Candidate has specific AI-assisted real work, plus measurable efficiency OR legal commercial deliverable and validation plan; no generic income hype
- [ ] All financial/platform policy is current; no misleading orders, KYC/tax/identity or copyright terms, cross-border rule tricks; no invented revenue
- [ ] Value gate is eligible and scorecard meets threshold; no hard-stop exception
- [ ] Reader can identify an **observable output**, not just tool familiarity.
- [ ] Every necessary command, required account and credential placeholder is included and safe.
- [ ] Environment tested or clearly NOT tested. "Full verified tutorial" requires genuine PASS evidence.
- [ ] Stages have input/action/expected output/verification and at least two real or credible failure fixes.
- [ ] Public sample data/screenshots sanitized and licensed; private API keys/tokens not committed.
- [ ] Links include actual source/project, tested revision, limitations and rollback where appropriate.
- [ ] If this is "自建节点", unambiguous node type and law/provider rules have been confirmed.
- [ ] One actual original English X copy **plus a verified matching 16:9 PNG/JPG and ALT**.
- [ ] No synthetic video/screenshot falsely presented as a real run; no unsupported earnings claims.
- [ ] GitHub tutorial link actually exists before writing "full tutorial at link"; X publication URL actually exists before marking published.
